longo.titulo: Why Did the Edmund Fitzgerald Vanish Minutes After "We Are Holding Our Own"?
longo.descricao:
"We are holding our own." That was the last message from the Edmund Fitzgerald, as reported by the Arthur M. Anderson. Minutes later she was gone, with 29 men and no distress call.

On November 10, 1975, the biggest ship ever lost on the Great Lakes vanished in a Lake Superior storm. The Coast Guard and the safety board blamed her hatches. Others disagree, including a member of that board.
